data.name: SuperNatural Market: Sell or Die
data.detailed_description:
Not a Normal Market

SuperNatural Market is a first-person supernatural market management simulator set in a strange post-pandemic neighborhood.

Stock the shelves, order products, make sales at the checkout, and try to keep your store alive. But your customers are not exactly normal. Zombies, werewolves, cyborgs, vampires, and even stranger locals visit your market every day.

Sell Products, Stock Shelves, Survive

Buy products to grow your market, keep your shelves stocked, and make sure you have what your customers want. Scan items at the checkout, take payments, and get ready for the next customer.

Some customers come to shop.
Some stare at the shelves in strange ways.
Some try to run away without paying.

What Happened to This Neighborhood?

You can simply run your market, make money, and try to get through the day.

But once you step outside your store, you start to realize this neighborhood is stranger than it first appears. Closed shops, weird rumors, talks of a black market, and a mysterious man named Viktor slowly pull you into a much bigger story.

Side Effect Island was once a closed test zone used for the second-phase experiments of VITA-33. According to official records, the experiments were shut down years ago.

Talk to customers, explore the neighborhood, and pay attention to every rumor if you want to learn why this world became the way it is.

Use Your Shoe Against Thieves

Security works a little differently in this neighborhood.

If you see someone stealing products, it is your job to stop them. Hit them up close, throw your shoe if you have to, recover the stolen goods, and put them back on the shelf.

Strange Products, Strange Deliveries

Sell brain-flavored drinks to zombies, motor-oil fruit juice to cyborgs, and special garlic-free products to vampires. Place your orders from your computer and wait for the deliveries.

Here, delivery does not come to your door.
It comes from the sky.

Key Features

  • Market management: Order products, stock shelves, make sales, and grow your store.

  • Supernatural customers: Zombies, werewolves, cyborgs, vampires, and more.

  • Open neighborhood exploration: Leave your store, talk to characters, and discover why this world became the way it is.

  • Absurd comedy: A normal day at the market can quickly turn into a ridiculous neighborhood incident.

  • Thief system: Stop customers who steal products, recover your goods, and put them back on the shelves.

  • UFO delivery: In this neighborhood, your orders do not always arrive the normal way.

data.short_description: Run a supernatural supermarket for zombies, vampires, werewolves, and cyborgs. Stock your shelves, grow your business, gamble at the bar, hire muscle, and sabotage rival stores. But be ready when they strike back. Explore the strange neighborhood, uncover its dark secrets, and remember: sell or die.
